description: Source code for Kubernetes Pod Garbage Collection Controller, managing pod lifecycle cleanup including orphaned, terminated, and terminating pods.

classes.name: PodGCController
classes.description: Controller responsible for garbage collecting pods based on termination, orphaned status, and node availability.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the garbage collection controller, runs main gc loop until context is done.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection tasks: terminates, orphaned, and unscheduled pods cleanup.

methods.name: gcTerminating
methods.description: Deletes pods that are terminating on out-of-service nodes.

methods.name: gcTerminated
methods.description: Deletes pods that are terminated beyond a threshold to free resources.

methods.name: gcOrphaned
methods.description: Deletes pods assigned to nodes that no longer exist.

methods.name: discoverDeletedNodes
methods.description: Identifies nodes that have been deleted after quarantine period.

methods.name: checkIfNodeExists
methods.description: Checks if a node with given name exists in the cluster.

methods.name: gcUnscheduledTerminating
methods.description: Deletes pods that are terminating but not scheduled to any node.

methods.name: markFailedAndDeletePod
methods.description: Marks a pod as failed and deletes it.

methods.name: markFailedAndDeletePodWithCondition
methods.description: Marks a pod as failed with a specific condition and deletes it.
